notes.title: v0.1.0.373
notes.content:
Hey Everyone.

This is the first update after our Early Access release. We will try to release weekly updates for the game.

This update includes city map changes. We have removed the canal, it was a big unused space in the map with no purpose, it is replaced with a forest. Also the forest in outer region of the city is removed since after every spawn in the outer region, players were trying to get back to city central. The wall surronding the city is also improved. The players now enter the game from the tunnels under the walls.

After getting lots of feedback for the weapons in the game, we changed all to classic set of weapons. All of the character animations are updated according to replaced weapons. Bullets coming out of the weapons also have some realistic sound and impact fx on the target surfaces.

[u][b]ChangeLog Summary[/b][/u]

- Weapons Updates - Switched with classic/realistic ones.
- Bullet Impacts Improved. Now, 6 different surfaces have different impact and bullet fx.
- Wall Model Updated. Players enter city through tunnels.
- Some missing collisions fixed.
- Forest Added. Forest assets improved.
- Character Animations Improved.

TPG Team.
